title: Rational-point local rings, jets and coordinate evaluation
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $B$ be a commutative $k$-algebra, and let $x:B\to k$ be a $k$-algebra homomorphism [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Define the point prime $\mathfrak p_x=\ker(x)$ in $\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] and the rational-point local ring $A_x=B_{\mathfrak p_x}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. For every integer $N\geq0$, define the jet algebra $\operatorname{Jet}(x,N)=A_x/\mathfrak m_x^N$, where $\mathfrak m_x$ is the maximal ideal of $A_x$, and its canonical quotient map $\operatorname{jetMap}_{x,N}:A_x\to\operatorname{Jet}(x,N)$. Define $\operatorname{JetIdeal}(x,N)$ as the image of $\mathfrak m_x$ under this quotient map, regarded as a $k$-linear subspace; when $N\geq1$ it is $\mathfrak m_x/\mathfrak m_x^N$. For an ideal $K\subseteq B$ and $y:B/K\to k$, define $\operatorname{quotientPoint}(K,y)=y\circ(B\to B/K)$. Finally, for commutative $k$-algebras $C,E,D$ and $k$-algebra maps $c:E\to E\otimes_k C$, $q:E\to D$ and $t:C\to D$, define $\operatorname{evaluate}(c,q,t)=(q\otimes t)\circ c$, with the map $E\otimes_k C\to D$ sending $e\otimes h$ to $q(e)t(h)$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-pushout-universal-property]. No finite-type, smoothness, action, or reducedness assumption is part of these definitions.
